appDescription.message: Find and save web videos you are authorised to access.

listenDescription.message: You will be asked before anything is downloaded.

readyWithoutService.message: No other program needs to be started

listeningHelp.message: Start playback and detected videos will appear here.

listeningOffHelp.message: Turn it on, then play the video you want to save.

noVideosListening.message: Listening. Play a video to see save options here.

noVideosOff.message: Turn on detection to find videos.

chooseSaveMethod.message: Direct download is recommended. Use web-assisted saving when playback must remain active.

assistedTaskCreated.message: Web-assisted saving created. Keep the download page open and continue playback.

ignoredThisTime.message: Ignored this time. Nothing will be downloaded.

downloadCenterDescription.message: View progress, continue downloads, and find saved files.

noDownloadTasks.message: No downloads yet. Detect and play a video, then create one from the extension popup.

chooseFolderIntro.message: Choose or create a dedicated subfolder, such as Downloads/Web Keeper. For safety, browsers do not grant direct access to the Downloads, Desktop, or Documents root folder.

diagnosticsDescription.message: Open this only when something goes wrong.

settingsDescription.message: These options affect future actions and never move or delete existing files.

showDiagnostics.message: Show the diagnostics entry on download pages

reloadForLanguage.message: Language updated. Reopen other extension pages to apply it.

directReadyMessage.message: Ready to download. The finished file uses browser Downloads by default.

assistedReadyMessage.message: The task is ready. Return to the original page and continue playback.

folderPermissionNeeded.message: The save location needs permission again. Select Continue.

taskPausedMessage.message: Download paused. Saved content has been kept.

temporaryFilesDeleted.message: Temporary files for this download were cleaned. The generated video remains.

deleteTemporaryConfirm.message: Clean temporary files for this download? Generated videos and previously saved content will remain.

browserUnsupportedFolder.message: This browser cannot write directly to a selected folder. Use the latest Chrome or Edge.

taskNotFound.message: This video is no longer available here. Return to the page, play it briefly, then reopen the extension.

playlistNotFound.message: Complete video information has not been detected yet. Return to the page, play briefly, then retry.

playlistEmpty.message: No downloadable video content was found.

unsupportedEncryption.message: This video encryption method is not supported yet: $METHOD$

keyLengthInvalid.message: Video decryption information is invalid ($COUNT$ bytes).

folderNeedsPermission.message: The save location needs permission again.

folderPermissionDenied.message: Write access to the save location was not granted.

downloadedItemTooSmall.message: Downloaded item $INDEX$ is only $SIZE$ bytes and below the valid segment size, so it was ignored.

tinySegmentDiscarded.message: Segment $INDEX$ is only $SIZE$ bytes, so it was treated as invalid and left for retry.

tinySegmentNeedsRetry.message: Segment $INDEX$ is only $SIZE$ bytes and neighboring timestamps are not continuous ($REASON$), so it will be retried.

segmentMarkedSkippable.message: Segment $INDEX$ can be skipped: neighboring timestamps already line up (gap about $DELTA$s, playlist about $EXPECTED$s), so it will not be retried.

skippableSegmentsNote.message: $COUNT$ empty/skippable segment(s) confirmed (neighbors are continuous; no retry).

creatingPlayableVideoSkippable.message: Creating a playable video; $COUNT$ confirmed empty segment(s) will be skipped.

outputCompleteSkippable.message: Created $NAME$. Skipped $COUNT$ empty segment(s) because neighboring timestamps were continuous.

skippableVerdictsCleared.message: Cleared previous skippable verdicts ($REASON$) and will reassess using the current segment timeline.

timelineRecheckAfterPause.message: Paused for about $MINUTES$ minute(s). Previous skippable verdicts were cleared, and new segments will be checked for timeline alignment. If they no longer match, a break is marked and downloading continues.

timelineShiftDetected.message: Segment $INDEX$ does not line up with neighboring saved segments (gap about $DELTA$s, $REASON$). The source/session may have changed after a long pause. Previous skippable verdicts were cleared; gaps will be rechecked. Keep the same quality before continuing.

timelineShiftAdjusted.message: Timeline changed at segment $INDEX$ (gap about $DELTA$s, $REASON$). A discontinuity was marked there, old skippable verdicts were cleared, and downloading continues.

timelineBreaksNote.message: $COUNT$ timeline break(s) were marked automatically after a source/session change; downloading continues.

creatingWithTimelineBreaks.message: $COUNT$ marked timeline break(s) are present; timestamps will be remapped where possible while creating the video.

stallAtMissingHint.message: The player is near the gap $START$ – $END$.

stallFarFromMissingHint.message: The player is near $TIME$, about $SKEW$s away from the nearest gap $START$ – $END$.

stallSmartFillAlert.message: Progress has not increased for about $SECONDS$ seconds. $PLAYER$$HINT$Confirm the page is still loading, or play the gap manually before continuing assisted fill.

stallDirectAlert.message: Progress has not increased for about $SECONDS$ seconds. Continue later, or switch to web-assisted saving.

stallCaptureAlert.message: Progress has not increased for about $SECONDS$ seconds. $PLAYER$$HINT$Return to the page to play, enable auto-seek, or use assisted gap filling.

smartFillNothingMissing.message: No missing segments are detected right now.

smartFillSeekSkew.message: The player is at $ACTUAL$, far from the target gap $START$ – $END$. Retrying the seek; if this keeps failing, drag there manually.

smartFillRangeStillMissing.message: This gap is still incomplete (about $START$ – $END$, $COUNT$ item(s) left). Make sure the page plays that time, then continue.

smartFillNextRange.message: This gap was handled. Next gap is about $START$ – $END$ ($COUNT$ item(s), $REMAINING$ gap(s) left). Auto-seeking continues.

directDownloadWorking.message: Getting video content and saving unfinished parts. You can leave this page in the background, but keep the browser open.

allContentSaved.message: All video content is saved. Creating a playable file now.

recoverableDownloadError.message: $ERROR$ Saved content has been kept. Return to the page, refresh it, and continue.

assistedWorking.message: Following web playback and saving content without requesting ahead.

assistedWaiting.message: $ERROR$ Return to the video page and continue playback. Web Keeper will wait for new content.

assistedSaving.message: Following playback and saving content. Completed content is kept and you can pause at any time.

assistedItemFailed.message: One part could not be saved yet: $ERROR$. It will be retried automatically.

assistedItemGaveUp.message: One part failed several times: $ERROR$. Use assisted gap filling, or replay that part of the page.

captureSpeedApplied.message: Playing muted at $RATE$x to save faster. If the player cannot keep up, use assisted gap filling for what is missed.

captureSpeedLimited.message: The site limited playback to $ACTUAL$x, so $WANTED$x is not possible.

captureSeekBoostApplied.message: Now seeking about +$STEP$ seconds every $INTERVAL$ second(s) (like Right Arrow). This does not need player speed control.

captureSpeedFallbackSeek.message: No speed-controllable player was found, so automatic seeking (+$STEP$s every $INTERVAL$s) is used instead.

captureSpeedFallbackSeekLimited.message: The site does not allow $WANTED$x (about $ACTUAL$x now), so automatic seeking (+$STEP$s every $INTERVAL$s) is used instead.

captureSeekBoostEnded.message: Seeking reached near the end. Use assisted gap filling if anything is still missing.

captureQualityAdopted.message: Now saving the quality the player is actually using.

captureLiveWaiting.message: Live content keeps saving. Choose Check and create video when you want to stop.

captureQualityChanged.message: The player switched quality. This task keeps saving the original quality only. Lock the quality on the page to avoid gaps.

remainingCount.message: $COUNT$ item(s) still need to be filled.

createPartialConfirm.message: $COUNT$ item(s) are still missing. Create an incomplete video from available content?

creatingPartial.message: Creating a video from available content and skipping $COUNT$ gap(s).

outputComplete.message: Created $NAME$. After checking playback, you can clean the temporary download files.

badgeVideoFound.message: Web Keeper: video found — choose how to save it

candidateGone.message: This video is no longer available. Play it again and retry.

directFileUrlMissing.message: The file download address was not found. Return to the page, play it again, and retry.

directFileWorking.message: Saving the video file directly. If interrupted, it can continue from the bytes already written.

dashNotReady.message: This video uses separate audio and video tracks. Web Keeper detected them, but this version cannot merge them reliably yet. Choose web-assisted saving or wait for DASH support.

mediaTypeUnsupported.message: A video request was found, but this version cannot identify how to save it yet.

removeTaskConfirm.message: Remove this task from the download centre? Saved files and resumable content will be kept.

rangeNotSupported.message: The site did not return the requested media range. The download was stopped to avoid creating a damaged video.

dashManifestMissing.message: Complete DASH video information has not been found. Return to the page, play briefly, then retry.

dashWorking.message: Downloading the video and audio tracks. Completed parts can be resumed later.

dashInitMissing.message: This video did not provide usable track initialization information.

dashNoTracks.message: No directly downloadable DASH audio or video tracks were found.

dashMerging.message: The video and audio tracks are downloaded. Creating one playable file now.

drmUnsupported.message: This video is DRM-protected. Web Keeper will not attempt to bypass the site's access controls.

directStalled.message: Direct download has no new content for now. Continue later, or confirm a switch to web-assisted saving.

liveWaiting.message: Waiting for the site to publish more content. Saved parts will not be lost.

switchToAssistedConfirm.message: Switch to web-assisted saving? Keep this task page open and continue playback on the original page.

interruptedReadyToResume.message: The previous run stopped when its page closed. Saved content is still available; select Continue to resume.

noTaskForVideo.message: No download has been created for this video yet.

smartFillConfirm.message: Start assisted gap filling? Web Keeper will seek the original page to missing positions and slow down or stop when loading cannot keep up.

smartFillWorking.message: Playing the missing positions. Web Keeper will wait when the player loads slowly.

videoElementNotFound.message: No controllable video player was found on the original page. Play the indicated position manually.

smartFillNoProgress.message: No new content arrived near $TIME$, so automatic seeking stopped. Play this position manually, then continue.

smartFillStillMissing.message: Automatic filling finished with $COUNT$ item(s) still needing manual playback.

smartFillComplete.message: Missing positions are filled. Checking the video now.

saveLocationUpdated.message: The save location was updated. Existing files were not moved.

saveLocationForgotten.message: The save location was forgotten. No files were deleted.

deleteOutputConfirm.message: Delete the generated video $NAME$? Temporary download content and the task record will be kept.

outputDeleted.message: $NAME$ was deleted. Other saved content is still available.

rememberForSite.message: Remember this site's recommended method and quality

hlsSeparateTracksUnsupported.message: This HLS video uses a separate audio format that cannot yet be combined reliably in the browser. Confirm web-assisted saving instead.

hlsMapIvRequired.message: The HLS initialization segment is encrypted without an explicit IV. Direct download stopped to avoid creating a damaged file; use web-assisted saving instead.

readyToCreateMessage.message: All content is downloaded and ready for video creation.

savedFileTooSmall.message: The result is only $SIZE$ and does not look like a complete video.

downloadReturnedDocument.message: The site returned a web page or error response instead of media data.

videoTrackMissing.message: Only an audio track was detected; there is no video picture. Replay the page to detect the complete video, or use web-assisted capture.

videoValidationFailed.message: The result did not pass video-track validation. The file and task were kept, but it was not marked complete and temporary data was not deleted.

transmuxerUnavailable.message: The media packaging component did not load, so a playable MP4 cannot be created.

unexpectedSegmentFormat.message: The downloaded parts are not a recognized video format. Video creation was stopped.

outputCompleteAndCleaned.message: $NAME$ was created and validated. Temporary parts were deleted automatically.

legacyOutputInvalid.message: The older output failed video validation: $ERROR$. The file and parts were kept. Replay the page and select Continue; Web Keeper will prefer the complete direct media response.

exportingToDownloads.message: Moving the validated video to the browser Downloads folder.

browserDownloadFailed.message: The browser could not save the finished file: $ERROR$

browserStorageUnavailable.message: The browser could not provide private extension download storage.

importLegacyCaptureHint.message: Choose data\captures, a work folder, or a quality folder to resume gaps / create video.

legacyAskProduct.message: You selected a quality folder. Enter the work name (for example ofje00435):

legacyPlaylistEmpty.message: Could not parse a segment list from $LABEL$.

legacySegmentsUnmatched.message: The playlist for $LABEL$ does not match the segment files in that folder.

legacyImportMissing.message: Imported $DONE$ segments; $MISSING$ gap(s) remain. Open the original page and switch to web-assisted saving to use smart fill / playback speed.

legacyImportReady.message: Imported $COUNT$ segments. You can create the video now. For subtitles or faster assisted capture later, open the original page and switch to web-assisted saving.

legacyImportStarting.message: Preparing to import $COUNT$ legacy quality folder(s)…

legacyFolderUnrecognized.message: No legacy capture folder was recognized. Choose data\captures, a work folder, or a quality folder that contains .ts files.

legacyKeyMissing.message: The legacy decryption key is not loaded. Re-import the folder, or reopen the task to restore the key.

directoryPickerUnavailable.message: This browser cannot open a folder picker.
